scope: Read-only incremental review of four previously reported charge-ledger defects

checks.conclusion: Summary rechecks Redis run_id and EPOCH after coverage/counter reads; the previously described restart/FLUSH during measurement is rejected.

limitations: Static review only; no tests executed or runtime Redis faults injected by this reviewer. Parent is running the real Redis 7.4.11 tests; their result is not asserted here.

Continuity still assumes no selective loss/reset of financial counter/coverage/stream keys while EPOCH survives. Such destructive operations require continuity review; run_id/EPOCH alone cannot certify them.
No claim of a distributed atomic transaction between Redis measurement and PostgreSQL approval, nor durability against host/process loss.
